description: Image Description: The image depicts a dirty and poorly maintained toilet in a public restroom. The toilet seat is open, revealing a stained bowl with yellowish water, indicating neglect and lack of cleaning. The toilet lid is covered in graffiti, including the words "DIRTY!!" written prominently in black marker, along with other scribbles and markings. A sticker with the letters "FUW" is affixed to the underside of the lid. The surrounding area shows signs of disrepair: the walls
